title: HarmonyBot Final Commercial Freeze Architecture One-Pass
diagnosis: Development was globally SELL-only even though harmonic direction is endogenous to the pattern; this creates regime fragility.
H4 existed in cache but the tested Development path did not require H4FilterEnabled, and the old soft MTF gate could admit counter-trend reversals.
M15 did not participate in entry-context arbitration although product requirements call for H4/H1/M15 conflict resolution.
Closed-bar micro confirmation was only mandatory in SmallAccount tactical execution, not in the $10k Development architecture gate.

The Fibonacci Grid added zero child baskets in Development, yet Grid-enabled parent management still used early R-based BE/trailing/scale-out settings; this can compress realized payoff before a 2R target.
A/B/C volatility exclusions removed trades but did not repair DEV-B, proving volatility-only filtering is not the missing state variable.
DEV-B loses in both 5-0 and Cypher, so pattern blacklist alone is not a robust solution.
architecture_changes: restore both BUY and SELL; remove global direction bias
block signals opposite an aligned H4+H1 regime
require universal closed-bar confirmation before entry
disable Fibonacci Grid for the commercial freeze candidate because it provided zero child-basket evidence and distorted payoff conversion
disable partial TP / early BE / early trailing during Development so the structural >=2R payoff is measured cleanly
keep harmonic pattern as the only primary setup; context and confirmation are filters, not independent entry signals

profiles.name: Balanced HTF/M15
profiles.logic: HTF consensus aligned is preferred; mixed H4/H1 requires M15 alignment and higher composite quality.

profiles.name: 2-of-3 Consensus
profiles.logic: At least two of H4/H1/M15 align with harmonic direction; composite quality >=0.60.

profiles.name: Strict 3-of-3
profiles.logic: H4/H1/M15 all align; stricter geometry/PRZ/composite quality and stronger closed-bar body confirmation.

selection: Only profiles passing all Development gates are eligible. Rank by worst-window PF, aggregate expectancy, lower DD, then frequency.
stop_rule: No post-hoc profile or threshold changes after launch. If no profile passes Development, final status is STRATEGY_ARCHITECTURE_LIMITATION. If downstream mandatory gate fails, final status is HOLD. Final Holdout is used once only.

historical_walk_forward.gate: aggregate PF > 1, aggregate expectancy/net > 0, each window DD <= 10%, execution errors = 0
